intro: Explore Torremolinos on Spain’s Costa del Sol: sandy beaches, the historic centre, La Carihuela seafood restaurants, family attractions and easy day trips to Málaga and Benalmádena. Plan your holiday and save memories and photos on your device.

areas.name: Torremolinos Town Centre
areas.description: Explore Calle San Miguel, cafés, shops and the historic centre.

areas.name: La Carihuela
areas.description: Seafront neighbourhood known for seafood restaurants and its long promenade.

areas.name: Bajondillo
areas.description: Popular central beach area below the town centre.

attractions.name: Molino de Inca Botanical Garden

transport.name: Málaga Airport
transport.description: Málaga–Costa del Sol Airport is the main airport; confirm transport and schedules.

transport.name: Cercanías C1 train
transport.description: Suburban rail connects Torremolinos with Málaga Airport, Málaga city and Fuengirola; check Renfe timetables.

transport.name: Local buses
transport.description: Check current bus routes for Torremolinos, Benalmádena and Málaga.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Seafront is mostly level, but the town centre is uphill from some beaches.

transport.name: Taxis
transport.description: Use licensed taxis and confirm fares and pickup locations.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Useful for regional trips; parking may be difficult near beaches in peak season.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check your bank’s foreign transaction charges.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK government advice for Spain, passport validity and travel insurance.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Spanish is the official language; English is commonly spoken in tourist areas.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow lifeguard flags, currents and weather warnings.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Mainland Spain is generally one hour ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Sun protection
useful.description: Carry water, sunscreen and a hat, particularly in summer.
